protocol.primary_detection: Object F1 at bounding-box IoU >=0.5 on the same completed public test images. Mask models are converted to boxes with common4-neighbor/min25px components. GPT positive boxes only; uncertain abstentions separate.
protocol.secondary_detection: Object F1 at IoU0.25 and image-level presence metrics.
protocol.mask_ranking: Micro pixel IoU across all public images after min25px filtering, with Dice and absolute area error. No pixel mask or IoU is invented for GPT boxes.
protocol.ties: Primary detection ties retain co-winners; recall and precision are shown, not hidden behind an opaque score.
protocol.eligibility: Only entrants with valid completed predictions on every public test image are ranked. Partial predictions and blocked access are visible but unranked. Enhanced inputs form a separate board.
protocol.local_images: Incomplete provisional references support only hit diagnostics; no formal precision, recall or pixel accuracy.
protocol.sampling: 8 public crops,4positive-targeted/4reference-empty by predeclared alternating tile order; convenience sample, not municipal prevalence.
protocol.generalization: Published corpus selected around >=30kWp plants, domain proxy for under30kW rooftop goal. Scores against supplied labels do not guarantee absence of omitted PV.
protocol.runtime: Concurrent model runtimes and subscription/network latency are not isolated hardware speed benchmarks.

images.rgbi_rgb_mismatch_note: Original RGBI TIFF RGB bands differ slightly from WMS PNG; not a pure NIR ablation.

limitations: Public labels are from a released selected benchmark, not a random municipal survey.

PV-specific pretrained weights were not fine-tuned locally.

End-aligned windows may overlap by more than the requested eighty pixels.
Concurrent CPU timings are not an isolated model-speed benchmark.
